verdict.rationale: The evidence documents GPU acceleration for Metal, NVIDIA, AMD and Vulkan, but no first-party documentation describes diagnostic output explaining why GPU initialization failed and fell back to CPU. Community reports show CPU fallback does happen: one user saw a compile error before a CPU run, and another found processing on the CPU without knowing why. Neither shows a product-provided diagnostic feature for this story.

support.subject: As a power-user, I know why GPU acceleration failed and silently fell back to CPU through clear diagnostic output
